Diagnosed and fixed the defect behind 60 of 60 failed CI runs. Made CI legible first: setup-python pins 3.12 and the Tests step re-emits failing tests as ::error:: annotations, which GitHub's public check-run API returns without admin rights. That named the failing test (test_land_resolves_generated_index_conflicts_by_regenerating), which failed only on modern git; reproduced with git 2.56.0 from micromamba and found two old-git assumptions: git rebase --continue opens an editor from git 2.26 (land then blocked 60s on a VM and failed outright on CI), and REBASE_HEAD survives a successful rebase since the merge backend, so land's 'still rebasing' check fired immediately after success while the module already had the correct rebase_in_progress predicate. land now forces the child's editor to a no-op via GIT_EDITOR/GIT_SEQUENCE_EDITOR (which outranks inherited config, unlike -c core.editor), uses rebase_in_progress, and quotes git's own first line via gitutil.detail. origin release check enforces RELEASE-MANIFEST.md, which said three times that nothing did. Six properties: no wildcards; every tracked top-level entry classified by exactly one table; a declared path exists unless marked (pending), and a pending one does not; no path sits inside a directory of the other audience; no classified path holds credential-shaped text; and the release state declared in the manifest matches the one in README.md. 29 tests seed one defect per clause into a throwaway repository, plus a fixture that passes. Run against the manifest as it stood, the check reported 14 violations: nine top-level entries (.agents/, .github/, .gitignore, RELEASE-MANIFEST.md, STATE-history.md, HYPOTHESES-results.md, the three FAILURES-findings*.md) classified by neither table and so published or withheld by accident, three paths declared public that do not exist (LICENSE, CONTRIBUTING.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, now marked pending), the missing release-state directive, and one credential-shaped fixture in the new test file itself - which is how D012's waiver earns a third use. All manifest gaps are closed in the same commit, which is manifest rule 2. A declared file classifies only itself, so docs/policy/one.md does not make docs/ public; .agents/ and .claude/ are declared as directories for that reason.
